defect: independent bit synchronizers do not preserve bus coherence
rationale: The arbitrary configuration word can change multiple bits; independent settling can create a word never sent.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Each bit goes through its own two-flop synchroniser; I accept the bits as independent per the case intent, though a transient mixed value is possible if they were a coded field (torn with unknown).

labels.by: gpt-6.1-sol (separate settling reader, the two cases and both arguments only)
labels.note: Asynchronous clocks are declared and four bits cross through separate two-flop synchronisers without word coherence. That is safe for independent controls and unsafe for one coded value, and the RTL gives no contract saying which applies.

settled_by: third reading; verdict unknown (all three readings differed; unknown is the reading the RTL supports)
